items.q: What identifies a SIP dialog?
items.a: Call-ID plus the From tag and the To tag.

items.q: What identifies a transaction on a hop?
items.a: The Via branch parameter. In RFC 3261 it starts with z9hG4bK.

items.q: Why are there two kinds of ACK?
items.a: A 2xx ACK is its own end-to-end transaction. A non-2xx ACK belongs to the INVITE transaction and is hop-by-hop. RFC 6026 tightens the 2xx rules.

items.q: What is the recommended initial Max-Forwards?
What does 100 Trying mean?
items.a: The next hop has the INVITE and the previous hop can stop retransmitting. It does not mean the phone is ringing.

items.q: Name the compact form of Contact, To, From, and Via.
items.a: m, t, f, and v.

items.q: What is the difference between 401 and 407?
items.a: 401 is the UAS challenge and uses Authorization. 407 is the proxy challenge and uses Proxy-Authorization.

items.q: What creates a registration binding?
items.a: REGISTER, with Contact and an expiration. The registrar stores the binding.

items.q: What is 423?
items.a: Interval Too Brief. The registrar wants a longer Expires.

items.q: What does RFC 3263 add?
items.a: How to find a SIP server with NAPTR, SRV, and address records.

items.q: Which RFC is the current SDP specification?
items.a: RFC 8866, which obsoletes RFC 4566.

items.q: How must an answer line up with an offer?
items.a: Same number of m-lines, same order. Port 0 rejects a stream.

items.q: How do you match dynamic payload types?
items.a: By the encoding name in rtpmap, not by the payload type number.

items.q: What is strange about G.722 in rtpmap?
items.a: RFC 3551 uses clock rate 8000 even though the audio is 16 kHz.

items.q: Where do DTMF events belong if you follow the IETF media spec?
items.a: In RTP as telephone-event, RFC 4733. SIP INFO is a different mechanism.

items.q: What does a=sendonly mean for hold?
items.a: The offerer will send and not receive. The answerer should reply recvonly or inactive.

items.q: What is in an RTP packet that a capture uses to spot loss?
items.a: The sequence number. RTCP reports the loss fraction.

items.q: Name two SRTP keying styles and their RFCs.
items.a: SDES, RFC 4568, puts keys in SDP. DTLS-SRTP, RFC 5764, keys in the media path. SRTP itself is RFC 3711.

items.q: What is early media?
items.a: Media before the call is answered. RFC 3960 discusses it. 183 with SDP is the common signal, not a guarantee.

items.q: Why do NATs break SIP?
items.a: SIP and SDP name IP addresses and ports that the NAT does not know to rewrite consistently.

items.q: What does rport do?
items.a: It asks the peer to send the response to the source port it observed.

items.q: Which RFC is current for ICE, STUN, and TURN?
items.a: ICE is RFC 8445, STUN is RFC 8489, TURN is RFC 8656.

items.q: What is a relay candidate?
items.a: An address allocated on a TURN server.

items.q: Why is a SIP ALG dangerous?
items.a: It rewrites signaling or SDP in transit, often to a useless address, and it cannot see inside TLS.

items.q: Is P-Asserted-Identity cryptographic?
items.a: No. RFC 3325 is an assertion inside a trust domain. STIR, RFC 8224, is the cryptographic identity.

items.q: What token does STIR carry?
items.a: A PASSporT, RFC 8225.

items.q: Where are SHAKEN attestation rules published?
items.a: In ATIS SHAKEN specifications. The FCC call-authentication page is the regulator’s overview. Do not quote an attestation letter from memory without the current ATIS text.

items.q: Is there an SBC protocol RFC?
items.a: No. RFC 5853 records requirements. The device is usually a B2BUA, RFC 7092.

items.q: What is topology hiding?
items.a: Rewriting the signaling so the inside addresses and headers are not shown to the outside. It is a B2BUA behavior.

items.q: What does debug ccsip messages show?
items.a: SIP messages the IOS voice stack sent and received.

items.q: How does a CUBE SIP profile differ from a CUCM SIP Profile?
items.a: CUBE voice class sip-profiles is a header rewrite list. A CUCM SIP Profile is a trunk settings object.

items.q: What is early-offer forced?
items.a: A CUBE dial-peer setting that sends the SDP offer in the outbound INVITE.

items.q: What does the IOS trusted IP list prevent?
items.a: VoIP call setups from addresses that are not trusted. It is the documented toll-fraud control. Confirm the list size in the guide for your platform.

items.q: Which three names does Direct Routing publish for SIP?
items.a: sip.pstnhub.microsoft.com, sip2.pstnhub.microsoft.com, and sip3.pstnhub.microsoft.com, port 5061.

items.q: Why does Teams reject a Contact that contains an IP address?
items.a: Direct Routing requires the SBC FQDN in Contact, matching the certificate. An IP is refused with 403.

items.q: How is Webex premises PSTN different from Cloud Connected PSTN?
items.a: Premises PSTN uses your Local Gateway and carrier. Cloud Connected PSTN is a cloud partner. A location uses one of them.

items.q: Does Amazon Connect need a SIP trunk for ordinary PSTN calls?
items.a: No. Connect provides the voice channel. External SIPREC into a connector is a different feature. Chime Voice Connector is not a supported shortcut into Connect without a specialist review.

items.q: What is Twilio termination versus origination?
items.a: Termination is your system calling the PSTN. Origination is the PSTN calling your system. The Request-URI on termination must reference the trunk’s termination URI.

items.q: What do you agree before you turn up a carrier trunk?
items.a: Transport and certificates, codecs including telephone-event, E.164 format, which side offers, SRTP keying, trusted addresses, and OPTIONS.

items.q: What is the first question in a one-way-audio ticket?
items.a: Did signaling complete, and which address and port does each SDP name?
